author: Bellular News
description:
PlayStation says it wants to revitalise live service, just as Bungie gets cut to the bone. The studio Sony bought to lead that future has lost senior talent, Destiny expertise and trust. This is not PlayStation quitting live service. It is a very different plan taking shape, and Bungie paid the price.
